translation: When this work was compiled, he sometimes obtained incomplete books, and because of their missing passages, many have incomplete meaning and principle. Moreover, from the Tang through the Five Dynasties, the copies were transmitted and written, with errors especially severe; even the Hongdu secret repository had no good copy. The state ordered the Confucian ministers to correct the medical books. I, your servant, receiving the command, deleted the important of the book's formulas and evidence to follow its brevity, and annotated the differences of the canonical books to make manifest their detail, so that the errors of lu and yu, shi and hai were made clear and bright.
